seed: The third guide of the Looks track teaches the lens on the case people actually have: an address in a screenshot they are about to send on. The guide brings an account screen of its own, flattened the way a capture is, and the walk drives the whole thing: K, one drag over the address, the strength pulled up, and the same lens switched to blocks. The middle of it is the claim that the strength step MEANS its words: nudged one point the guide waits, one point short of the mark it still waits, and it moves on the moment the setting really reaches 16.

steps.note: the guide brought an account screen with a name and an address on it, flattened into the picture the way a real capture is
a waiting step aimed at the lens button in the tool bar, which has a slot of its own so it is always on screen
THE TEST: one drag hid the address and the guide moved on by itself. The panel opened and scrolled to the lens's own settings

THE TEST: Strength nudged one point and the guide has NOT moved on. The smear still carries the rhythm of the words, which is what the step is asking to take away, and it waits for the setting to really reach 16 rather than for the slider to be touched
one point short of the mark, and still waiting: the threshold is a line, not a nudge

a pull that swept up to 40 and came back to 12 before letting go. The picture followed the pull the whole way, and the guide did not move on for it: what counts is where the slider was LET GO, not the highest number it passed through
the moment Strength reached 16 the guide moved on by itself, and the address is one even bar rather than a soft one with word shapes in it
the same lens switched to blocks, which is what most people want over a name: it reads as hidden on purpose
Done closed the guide and left the lens on the picture
